title: Repairing Attachment
learning_goal: Understand how to repair attachment after DFV exposure.

content.micro_lesson: Attachment repair is possible through consistent presence, attunement, predictable responses, and safe emotional expression. Small moments of connection rebuild trust.
content.activity: Complete a 10-minute guided 'connection task' with the child.
content.evidence_required: Short reflection on the connection task.
content.caseworker_flags: Child avoids all physical contact or caregiver emotionally unavailable.
content.escalation_trigger: Signs of attachment rupture trigger therapeutic referral.
